result.title: Boltz-Flow: Generating High-Quality Robot Action from Boltzmann Machine
result.summary: Flow-matching policies integrate a velocity field from a fixed, observation-independent Gaussian source. However, since the source is unimodal and identical across all tasks, the limited representational capacity of Gaussian distributions constrains how far a policy can scale with growing task diversity. Moreover, the source factorizes over time steps and control dimensions, discarding the coordination that manipulation requires. We introduce Boltz-Flow, which replaces Gaussian initialization with a more powerful, observation- and instruction-conditioned Boltzmann source while leaving the base VLA unchanged. Boltz-Flow parameterizes this source with a conditional Boltzmann machine that assigns an energy value to each binary source state. A listwise objective, supervised entirely by offline demonstrations, aligns this energy with the quality of actions produced after frozen flow integration. At inference, the energy defines an Ising instance whose solution is decoded into continuous noise before a single standard integration. We use a physical coherent Ising machine during training. Experiments show that Boltz-Flow improves $π_{0.5}$ across three benchmarks, outperforming the compared strong policy baselines and competing noise optimization methods on LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0 and ranking second only to LEAP on LIBERO-Plus. Additional experiments show gains under noise-adapted fine-tuning, with action-to-action warm starts, and on the SmolVLA backbone.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Boltz-Flow，用观测与指令条件的 Boltzmann 机替换 flow-matching 策略固定的高斯初始噪声源，以 listwise 目标让能量对齐冻结积分后动作的质量，推理时将能量定义的 Ising 实例解码为连续噪声。
AI.relevance_reason: 以条件能量模型学习并监督 latent 起点、按最终输出质量回传目标，可能为 LVR 中初始推理状态设计与信用分配提供核查线索，但论文本身面向机器人动作生成，不涉及视觉推理状态的生成与更新。
